notes_review: The logged calls are sound: Marx defines relative surplus population and the industrial reserve army in p034 and p036, so the §7 wording is rightly left out; the former/latter cases in p044 are resolved correctly; and the open pronouns in p048 and p050 are kept as open as in the original.
summary: The paragraphs and footnotes, including the census figures in n. 14 and the Barton/Ricardo/Jones/Ramsay chain in n. 15, match the original in content, strength and attribution. The rewrite reads plainly and keeps the irony ("beautiful law", "beau ideal", Sancho Panza) intact.
